verdict.rationale: CoreWeave AI Object Storage offers S3-compatible access to GPU compute and a Local Object Transport Accelerator (LOTA) with cache warming for faster reads, now on CPU nodes too. Console upload/download, token-exchange credentials, multipart cleanup, conditional writes and fast RenameObject round out the data-movement story. Missing for 10: documented cloud-storage sync or migration tooling from other providers, explicit bulk-transfer tool guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of transfer performance.
